header.title: OpenAEC Installer
header.heroAlt: OpenAEC Installer: overview with Update all, a featured update of Open PDF Studio, filters by status and discipline, and the desktop app cards
header.label: All tools in one place
header.tagline: Install, update and launch every OpenAEC app from one place
header.desc: The Installer knows every app of the OpenAEC Foundation. It sees what is on your computer, puts the latest version in place in one click and keeps everything up to date. The web tools open in their own tab.

meta.description: Free, open-source hub for every OpenAEC app: discover, install in one click, update safely and launch, with the web tools in tabs. For Windows, macOS and Linux.
meta.title: OpenAEC Installer — OpenAEC Foundation

update.alt: Installed apps in the dark theme: Open Calc Studio and Open Planner Studio are current, Open PDF Studio and Open Pointcloud Studio have an update, and Open Geotechniek Studio is updating (64%)
update.title: Always the latest version, without searching
update.desc: Every card shows the version you have and the one that is ready. One click updates an app, or all of them at once. The Installer waits until you have closed the app, so you lose no work, and starts it again afterwards.

discover.alt: Catalogue in the Blueprint theme, filtered on Engineering: cards of Open PDF Studio, Open 2D Studio, Open CAD Studio, Open Calculations Studio, Open Geotechniek Studio and Open Speech Studio
discover.title: Find the app that fits your trade
discover.desc: Every app in the ecosystem is in one catalogue, with a short description and a picture. Filter by architecture, engineering, construction or infra, by what you already have or by updates, or search by name.

web.alt: OpenBooks open in a tab of the Installer, next to tabs for the Catalogue, Open Planner Studio and Open PDF Studio
web.title: Web tools in a tab, without installing
web.desc: Web tools and the web versions of the desktop apps open in tabs inside the Installer. Switch between them without losing your place; your tabs are back the next time you start. Prefer your own browser? That works too.

look.alt: Settings in the dark theme, with the choice of Light, Dark, Blueprint, High contrast dark and High contrast light, and the text size
look.title: In the style of every OpenAEC app
look.desc: Choose from five themes, including Blueprint and two with high contrast, and from three text sizes. The Installer speaks Dutch and English and follows the language of your computer.

features.label: Features
features.heading: The whole OpenAEC ecosystem, at hand
features.sub: Start with the highlights, or pick a topic.

catalog.title: One catalogue
catalog.desc: Every OpenAEC desktop app and web tool, with description, picture and stage (alpha, beta, in development).

filters.title: Filter by trade and status
filters.desc: Architecture, Engineering, Construction and Infra, or only what you have or what has an update.

search.title: Search
search.desc: Search by name, description or category.

featured.title: Featured
featured.desc: At the top come the apps with a new version first, then a fixed pick from the ecosystem.

oneclick.title: One-click install
oneclick.desc: Fetches the app's official installer from GitHub and starts it, in the right version for your system.

detect.title: Sees what you have
detect.desc: Recognises which apps are already installed and which version, even if you installed them yourself.

launch.title: Launch
launch.desc: Start an installed app straight from its card.

linux.title: Linux without admin rights
linux.desc: On Linux, apps go into your own folder as an AppImage, with a shortcut in the menu.

versions.title: Version next to version
versions.desc: Every card shows your version and the latest, such as v2026.43.2 → v2026.44.4.

all.title: Update all
all.desc: Update every app with an update in one go.

silent.title: Update without losing work
silent.desc: On Windows the Installer downloads first, waits until you close the app, updates it silently and starts it again.

sameSetup.title: The same kind of installation
sameSetup.desc: An app installed for you only or for the whole computer stays that way, so it is never installed twice.

signed.title: Verified downloads
signed.desc: For apps with a digital signature, the Installer starts nothing if the signature is missing or wrong.

appButton.title: Update button in the apps
appButton.desc: Apps that support it report a new version themselves and let the Installer do the update.

self.title: Updates itself
self.desc: At every start the Installer checks for a new version of itself; updating is one click (Windows, and Linux with the AppImage).

feed.title: Fast and without limits
feed.desc: The versions of all apps come in at once, without hitting GitHub's limit.

tabs.title: Web tools in tabs
tabs.desc: Open Energy Studio, OpenBooks and the other web tools run in a tab inside the Installer.

webDesktop.title: Web version of desktop apps
webDesktop.desc: If a desktop app has a web version, try it in a tab first.

remember.title: Tabs stay open
remember.desc: Switching keeps your place, and your tabs are back at the next start.

browser.title: Or in your own browser
browser.desc: Every web tool also opens in your usual browser, in one click from its card.

themes.title: Five themes
themes.desc: Light, dark, Blueprint and two with high contrast, in the style of every OpenAEC app.

lang.title: Dutch and English
lang.desc: Follows the language of your computer, or choose yourself.

download.title: Download v0.2.9
download.lead: Free, no account needed. For Windows, macOS and Linux.
download.label: Download
download.mobileNote: OpenAEC Installer is a desktop app. Download it on your computer.

design.title: New design
design.desc: The dark panel and tiles of open-aec.com, with filters by status and trade, a featured app and Update all.

signed.title: Verified updates
signed.desc: Apps with a digital signature are only updated if it is correct.

silent.title: Silent updates
silent.desc: In the same kind of installation, only after you closed the app, which then starts again. Now also for Open Pointcloud Studio.

appButton.title: Update button in the apps
appButton.desc: The Installer tells the apps which version is ready; their Update button lets the Installer do the work.

feed.title: Faster version checks
feed.desc: All versions come from one overview instead of from GitHub per app, so there is no limit any more.

calver.title: Correct version comparison
calver.desc: An app that records its version on Windows with a short year no longer gets a false update.

whatsnew.label: New in v0.2.9
whatsnew.title: New look, safer updates
whatsnew.desc: On 29 and 30 October, v0.2.5 to v0.2.9 came out: a new design, verified and silent updates, an update button in the apps and faster version checks.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: Yes, the Installer itself: a small desktop app of about 5 MB on Windows. Then you install the other apps from the Installer. The web tools need nothing.

price.q: What does the OpenAEC Installer cost?
price.a: Nothing. The Installer is free and open source under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence, with no account or subscription. The apps it installs are free too.

systems.q: Which systems does it run on?
systems.a: Windows, macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) and Linux (.deb, AppImage and Snap). Installing, updating and launching apps works on Windows and Linux. On macOS the catalogue and the web tools work; installing apps is not possible there yet.

apps.q: Which apps can I install with it?
apps.a: Fourteen desktop apps, including Open PDF Studio, Open Planner Studio, Open Calc Studio, Open Geotechniek Studio, Open Pointcloud Studio and Monty IFC Viewer, and five web tools such as Open Energy Studio and OpenBooks. When an app is added, it appears in the catalogue after an Installer update.

safe.q: Where do the downloads come from?
safe.a: Always from the app's official releases on GitHub. If an app ships a digital signature, the Installer checks it while downloading and starts nothing if it is missing or wrong.

work.q: Do I lose work when an app is updated?
work.a: No. If the app is open, the Installer asks you to close it and waits; it never closes it itself. After the update the app starts again.

admin.a: Usually not. The Installer installs per user, and on Linux apps go into your own folder. Only an app installed for the whole computer asks for admin rights when it is updated.

tauri.desc: A small native app for Windows, macOS and Linux; Rust handles the downloads, the checks and the installation.

react.desc: The interface, built with the web package of the OpenAEC design 0.4: tokens, fonts and icons.

releases.desc: One release feed for all apps, with the GitHub API as a fallback and a one-hour cache.

minisign.title: Minisign signatures
minisign.desc: A signed latest.json per app, in the same format as the Tauri updater, with a release kit for the apps.

windows.desc: Detection through the registry, silent updates in the same kind of setup, per user or for the whole computer.

linux.desc: A managed folder in ~/.local/share with menu entries following the XDG standard, without admin rights.
